## Goal

_What should be true when this is done? One or two sentences._

## Why now

_What breaks, drifts, or stays unmeasured if this is not done?_

## Constraints from existing decisions

_D-XXX — what it forbids here. `DECISIONS.md` is a long, numbered log, and it only grows;
nobody reads all of it before starting, which is why its constraints have to travel inside
the issue. If nothing here was already decided, say so, and say how you checked._

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] _Checkable by someone who did not write the change._

## Verification

_How will this be checked? Name the command. When nothing can be run, say that plainly,
and say what was done instead._

## Out of scope

_Anything found along the way becomes its own issue._
